overview_description.description: FitLynk is a fitness and wellness platform that connects users with personal trainers, gyms, wellness professionals, and fitness-related services. The platform provides tools for discovering trainers, booking sessions, accessing workout programs, and managing fitness activities through digital features and mobile access. FitLynk also incorporates AI-driven coaching and wellness support aimed at helping individuals track goals, maintain routines, and engage with fitness communities.
